# openvswitch / odp_target

openvswitch's own fuzz target `odp_target` ([source](source/odp_target.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over ovs (openvswitch/ovs at 1d415764).

odp_flow_from_string / odp_flow_key_to_flow / odp_flow_key_from_flow / odp_flow_key_format and odp_actions_from_string / format_odp_actions; the reformatted strings are puts()'d, never compared to the input.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against ovs at commit 1d415764.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- after string -> ODP key -> flow -> ODP key, the regenerated key must fit ODPUTIL_FLOW_KEY_BYTES; violation only printf's and sets exit_code=1, and LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput discards parse_keys()'s return value, so the check never fails the run ([lines 73-77](source/odp_target.c#L73-L77)): prints only; confirmed in the binary.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch openvswitch` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `odp_target.plain` | 704,912 | `17b7dd6400c3edccb3e172a7e02318aeaf2e33556a0a6e247d77af8f0cb0fbaa` |
| ubsan | `odp_target.ubsan` | 4,670,392 | `15a83d884866c16d29b15858d6ffe87bb5324776cfe2bf6eae452928f21f03b7` |
| asan | `odp_target.asan` | 1,298,264 | `49cc5e55e6d95e3ccc292869249058ba845cd36dfa7bb4536835c4d7acda941d` |
| asan-ubsan | `odp_target.asan-ubsan` | 1,331,128 | `3d12f5fb1940d3828951ab4a19fe9ab95dab4a3d649b32ae4f173bec280e5b5e` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libcrypto.a` (a library from the build image), `libssl.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
